BL-1551 — A skipped respawn is recorded as a respawn: chase_sweep_lib's apply-inbox-item-action! writes a respawn telemetry row right after calling trigger-respawn!, whatever the adapter did, and handoffd's adapter returns after chase-respawn-skip-busy (or chase-respawn-error) without touching a pane - so the lifecycle ledger and the closing-ceremony packet count respawns that never happened (QA x12 on 2026-09-12, cleaner and architect x1 on 2026-09-13, every one a skip-busy); a respawn row means a launch script or rotation was invoked, a skipped attempt is its own type
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: a chaser telemetry row of type respawn keeps its meaning "the adapter invoked a launch script or a rotation"; an attempt the adapter did not carry out is recorded as respawn-skipped wit…
BL-1551 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1551" (or "reject BL-1551 <reason>") to act.
